_comment: Example request for one CI job's culprit-line lookup. state.lines is the full last-200-line window (trimmed here for readability); state.candidate_indices is the small set of lines code pre-selected as failure-signal lines (see decide.ts:selectCandidates). Jev only scores those candidates, one `noul` each, plus one abstain `noul`.

lines.text: ERROR: Missing required environment variable DATABASE_URL
npm ERR! Test failed.  See above for more details.

line_5.instructions: In state.lines, is the log line at index 5 the single line that most directly reveals the underlying cause of this CI job's failure, as opposed to a downstream symptom, an unrelated warning, retry/informational output, or a generic "exited with code" message?

criteria.true: this line is the root-cause line
criteria.false: this line is not the root-cause line

no_clear_culprit.instructions: Considering all lines listed in state.candidate_indices together, is it true that none of them alone clearly reveals the cause of the failure, because the real cause requires combining multiple lines or is not present in this log at all?

criteria.true: no single candidate line explains the failure
criteria.false: at least one candidate line clearly explains the failure
